target.title: fix(agents): reject aborted foreground exec with AbortError
target.body:
Closes #105681

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where canceling a foreground `exec` tool call via the agent `AbortSignal` still fulfilled the tool result as a normal process exit/failure payload. The agent manager could treat the tool as completed instead of aborted, so cancellation did not cleanly surface as an abort error on the tool path.

## Why This Change Was Made

Foreground abort already kills the child process, but the wrapper promise still resolved through `buildExecForegroundResult` after the process exited. This change records caller abort for foreground runs, clears any armed yield timer before kill (so the timer cannot resolve a "running" result first), waits for the existing process finalization promise, then rejects with the signal reason or a canonical `AbortError`. Backgrounded/yielded sessions remain detached and are not killed by the tool-turn abort. Timeouts and ordinary non-abort process failures still use the existing normalized result path.

**Fix quality check:** compatibility — no config/API surface change; performance — O(1) flag/timer clear on abort only; usability — abort surfaces as `AbortError` instead of a misleading completed tool result; security — no trust-boundary change.

## User Impact

When an operator or agent runtime cancels a foreground bash/exec tool mid-run, the tool promise rejects with `AbortError` after process finalization instead of returning a successful-looking failed/exit tool payload. Backgrounded process sessions are unchanged.

## Evidence

Verification host: **local macOS** (Crabbox bypass).

Focused Real proof (Vitest, real exec tool path):

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.test.ts -t "abort"
# Test Files  2 passed (2)
# Tests  8 passed | 62 skipped (70)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec.background-abort.test.ts
# Test Files  1 passed (1)
# Tests  7 passed (7)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/agent-core/src/agent-loop.test.ts -t "does not request another model turn after a tool aborts"
# Tests  1 passed | 24 skipped
```

Static substitute (closeout monitor: `pnpm check:changed` expanded into dependency install/reconcile; stopped and substituted):

```text
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD   # clean
node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts src/agents/bash-tools.test.ts  # pass
```

Commit: `5c5e1c559` on `fix/105681-exec-abort-reject`.

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: Caller abort of a foreground exec tool must reject with `AbortError` after process finalization, not fulfill a normal foreground result; yield timer must not win the race and resolve "running".
- Environment: local macOS, Node v24.17.0, checkout `openclaw` at branch `fix/105681-exec-abort-reject` (`5c5e1c559`), real shell exec via Vitest agent suite.
- Current-main contrast: On `main` (`94f018caa`), `onAbortSignal` only `run.kill()`s; `run.promise.then` always `resolve(buildExecForegroundResult(...))` for non-backgrounded runs, so abort fulfills as a normal tool result. Observed by source inspection of `src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts` and by the pre-fix expectation of the updated abort tests (they would pass without `.rejects` on main).
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.test.ts -t "abort"`
  2. Scenario A: abort during onUpdate of a multi-step shell command → expect reject `name: "AbortError"`.
  3. Scenario B: same with `yieldMs: 60_000` armed → expect reject `AbortError` (timer cleared; not "running").
  4. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec.background-abort.test.ts` — background sessions still not killed by tool abort.
- Evidence after fix: abort-filtered suite **8 passed**; background-abort suite **7 passed**; agent-loop abort regression **1 passed**. Failures reject with `AbortError` (native signal reason message when present).
- Control check: background abort tests still pass (tool abort does not kill already-backgrounded sessions); non-abort foreground success/failure paths untouched by the `toolAborted` gate.
- Observed result after fix: Foreground abort rejects after process finalization; yield-timer race does not resolve a running payload; backgrounded sessions remain intact.
- What was not tested: Full interactive multi-step OpenClaw agent session with operator `/stop` in a live channel UI (CS rank-up for competing PR #105726); live paid model transcript not required for this unit-or-source acceptance path.

## Linked context

Open non-ready linked PR #105726 also targets this issue (`status: needs proof`). This PR follows the same CS direction (post-finalization AbortError + yield timer clear) using the shared `createAbortError` helper and keeps a single focused commit on current `main`.
